content: SATLab congratulates Truong Xuan Hieu and Dr. To Van Khanh on their paper 'Solving Cyclic Antibandwidth Problem by SAT' accepted in Computational Optimization and Applications (COAP, Q1 ISI Springer)!

Official release of the academic monograph: 'Optimal SAT Encodings for Combinatorial Optimization Problems' (116 pages) authored by SATLab UET. Available for online reading and open-access PDF download on the lab website.
